purpose: Static educational tubarium reconstruction; independent acceptance/publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, original directed topology/winding, source reopen, two real separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, transformed counts/dimensions, true-solid contacts and whole-scene exposure.

Retain pendent fork and faceted hollow tubular construction. Correct imagegen OUTWARD facing mouths to INWARD facing thecal rows. Narrow divergence toward type drawing, not wide Y. No copied floating close-up geometry or artificial cap decoration. Personally inspect eight final512px views and lossless sheet; same-subject details for microscopic apertures.

Exactly two gently divergent, near-parallel PENDENT stipes descending from a conical proximal sicula. One row of overlapping simple tapered thecal tubes on the inward/ventral side of EACH stipe. Apertures point down-distally and inward; narrow unobstructed central gap persists. Reconstructed open thecal mouths have solid walls and a genuinely recessed lumen. Thecal count26 per stipe is a selected growth-stage abstraction, not biological constant. Type-centered D.murchisoni, lectotype BGS GSM6820b in2018 Fig16.1a plus museum actual specimen PRI111607. Not D.artus or broad obsolete Didymograptus assemblage. Whole skeletal colony, soft zooids omitted as unpreserved.
Complete original freeze, payload, dependency closure and diagnostic exact selected counts. No arbitrary exposure-fraction gate.
Exact GLB through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Unrun hardware GPU evidence stays unknown. CPU images never substitute.
Unrun intended composed-scene evidence stays unknown.
